name: FoodPrep Solutions
old_description: We're the leading provider of Kosher sharpening solutions and retain the highest level of rabbinical supervision.
about:
FoodPrep Solutions operates from its headquarters at 88 Hamilton Avenue in Stamford, Connecticut. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure, and no founders are named in available materials.

The business provides an all-in-one service for food-service operations, combining weekly or biweekly knife sharpening and exchange with food equipment sales, maintenance, and merchandise. Its sharpening programs cover commercial knives, grinder knives, can openers, plates, bowl choppers, HCM and VCM blades, and slicer or food-processor blades. The company states it supplies 100 percent of the knives in its exchange program, eliminating customer purchases, and serves accounts ranging from independent groceries to national chains.

FoodPrep Solutions targets restaurants, delis, bakeries, supermarkets, food-processing plants, and food-service management companies. Its client examples include mom-and-pop groceries, nationwide chains, and top food-service management firms that rely on the firm for sharpening, equipment, maintenance, and merchandise.

The company emphasizes its Kosher sharpening solutions under the highest level of rabbinical supervision as a key differentiator, along with a single-source model that bundles sharpening, equipment, maintenance, and merchandise to reduce vendor count.
